source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The Glassmaker
tts_text: The fire must ignite before anything else can happen. He would highlight the hottest point with a thin iron rod, and the solar heat from the sunlight at sunset was enough for the first melt. Long before dawn he was already at work. A solid base had to consolidate before the fluid would hold its shape, and the liquid glass turned like slow honey. The volume of the furnace mattered, and there was a minimum and a maximum for every batch. He lowered the vessel into the heat. He could feel the pulse of the flame, and a sudden impulse made him pull it back. A flood of orange light seemed to fluctuate across the floor. He had to bleed the air out slowly, then dry the surface before it cooled. The glass would bubble, and one bulb of air could ruin the whole piece. His work was a kind of gesture, a mortgage on his own patience. He tried to engage the material on its own terms. It was a cognitive task as much as a physical one, and he could recognize a good piece at a glance. The real challenge was never the glass, but the waiting. He planted a small flag on the shelf and set a global rule for himself.
